requirements.text: * Experience building and shipping software in a production environment
* Strong frontend fundamentals and experience with modern JavaScript and React. This is an important part of the role
* Experience with a server\-side web application language; Python/Django experience is strongly preferred
* Experience with a server\-side web application language; Python/Django experience is strongly preferred
* Familiarity with SQL and developing across frontend and backend systems
* Ability to break down product requirements, collaborate on technical approaches, and implement maintainable solutions
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to be flexible and adaptable in a dynamic environment
* Interest in contributing ideas and product perspective, not just executing predefined tasks
* 2\+ years of software development experience and a demonstrated ability to own projects with increasing independence. Level will be determined based on experience and demonstrated proficiency
* Experience with Storybook or other component\-driven development practices is a plus
* Eagerness to explore and apply AI tools and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done
* Willingness to participate in in\-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off\-sites, volunteer days, and team building exercises, as applicable to your location
* Interest in building relationships with teammates and contributing to Nextdoor's culture
